episodes.title: A True Hotel Is Always Storied
episodes.summary: Yachiyo and her staff are ready to welcome you to the Gingarou Hotel... except there's nobody left on Earth.

episodes.title: Tradition Evolves With Innovation and Experimentation
episodes.summary: The Gingarou Hotel gets its first guest in over a century, but he's not human! Do aliens even count as guests?

episodes.title: A Smile Is the Ultimate Ambiance
episodes.summary: A group of humans return to Earth... but not all is as it seems.

episodes.title: Food and Etiquette Are Mainstays of Culture
episodes.summary: Yachiyo and Ponko head out in search of new ingredients.

episodes.title: Provide Unlimited Hospitality in Limited Time
episodes.summary: A new pair of aliens arrive at the hotel, but the shortage of alcohol will be a problem.

episodes.title: Our Only Vice Is Service
episodes.summary: The end times have come to Earth... and it seems they will be staying at the Gingarou Hotel?

episodes.title: Bow Down Deep but Always Aim High
episodes.summary: The gang decides to launch a satellite for promotion, but Ponko has other ideas.

episodes.title: Discipline with a Fist! Reconcile with a High Five!
episodes.summary: What happens after Yachiyo gets stranded in space?

episodes.title: Bookmark Today's Page in Our Guests' Lives
episodes.summary: After reconciling with Yachiyo, Ponko has some news to share.

episodes.title: Clean Sheets Symbolize Pure Hearts
episodes.summary: The Gingarou receives an unnerving guest who requests total secrecy about his visit...

episodes.title: Wag Your Tail, but Never Wag a Shift!
episodes.summary: Labor standards say Yachiyo has been overworked, and Ponko demands that she take time off.

episodes.title: Aim to Be the Number One Hotel in the Galaxy
episodes.summary: Gingarou and Earth receive a visit from an old, old friend.
